profile.name: Cankat Tilki
profile.title: PhD Candidate in Mathematics
profile.bio: I am Cankat Tilki, a PhD candidate in the Department of Mathematics at Virginia Tech. I work with Dr. Serkan Güğercin on data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Outside research, I enjoy practicing aikido and traveling.
profile.research_summary: My research develops data-driven modeling and model reduction methods for complex dynamical systems. I work at the intersection of numerical analysis, Koopman operator theory, and Dynamic Mode Decomposition, with emphasis on wavelet-based observables and infinite-dimensional linear control systems.
